text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
For some reason, Shinko Windy<n>seems different
from her usual self...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I took the medicine my mom brought<n>me, so I
should get better right away,<n>but...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
My mom even rubbed my head... and<n>wished the
pain away, but...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy appears troubled by<n>her nagging
headache.
